page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.6xlarge belongs to the High Clock Speed instance family and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The virtual machine utilizes the x86_64 architecture, powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a 3.4 GHz clock frequency. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs paired with 96.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per allocated vCPU core.

Hardware configurations exclude integrated local disk storage, requiring the attachment of remote cloud block storage for operational filesystems and persistence. There are no discrete graphical processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses attached to the profile. Network throughput is provisioned with an 18 Gbps baseline bandwidth allocation, facilitating dependable transit between computational nodes and network-attached block volumes.

By delivering elevated per-core processing speeds combined with dedicated execution cores, the configuration addresses compute tasks sensitive to core frequencies without inflating memory capacity beyond standard proportions. The architecture is well matched to workloads such as continuous integration build systems, multiplayer game servers, financial simulations, batch data pipelines, and transactional application backends requiring sustained high-frequency CPU performance.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.6xlarge is a high clock speed virtual server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running on the KVM hypervisor. Built on x86_64 architecture, it delivers 24 dedicated vCPUs operating at 3.4 GHz alongside 96.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4.0 GB per core. The instance lacks bundled local storage, necessitating external network-attached volumes for operating system disks and application data persistence. Furthermore, it contains no discrete GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Network connectivity is supported by an 18 Gbps baseline bandwidth profile. Combining high base CPU clock frequencies with dedicated core allocation and balanced memory capacity, the ecs.hfg9i.6xlarge instance targets CPU-bound workloads requiring fast instruction cycle completion, including continuous integration tasks, game server hosting, financial batch modeling, and transactional web application tiers.
